en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the AV room.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?
Watch a documentary on bugs
Watch a documentary on cosplayers
Watch a documentary about anime
Bugs? Are you trying to be like Gonta?

You get along with everyone, Shuichi...
I'm a little jealous.

I can hang out with people, but I don't 
have many friends I can open up to...

Oh, but it's plain to see I can 
open up to you, Shuichi.

Umm...can we not watch 
this documentary?

I've seen it before. I couldn't feel any 
love for the source material from it.

Watching this only made me 
feel disappointed...

I watch movies like this when I get 
stuck in a rut with my cosplay.

Watching stuff like this lets me 
remember the value of the characters...

It reminds me the characters I cosplay 
are the children of many people...

That gets me fired up! There's no way 
I can do half-baked cosplay!

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Tsumugi looks deep in thought...
<CLT=cltMIND>Huh?
<CLT=cltMIND>That voice just now. Is that...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Is that Tsumugi's inner thoughts...?
